C x.log-levels EX RUN-013 DEFAULT ;; Log information that helps diagnose/operate and choose levels by operational meaning: Trace/Debug troubleshooting detail; Information normal meaningful events (not every method call); Warning recovered degraded conditions; Error failed operations needing attention; Critical subsystem cannot continue safely. ;; = ;; none ;; Log-level taxonomy not in the oracle.
C sec010.level-not-safe OL SEC-010 MUST_NOT ;; Debug or Trace level does not make sensitive data safe to log. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api012.log-where-handled OL API-012 MUST ;; Log an exception where the failure is handled or terminated; do not add another log entry when rethrowing without meaningful handling. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.log-scopes EX RUN-013 DEFAULT ;; Use ILogger.BeginScope when several entries need shared context. ;; = ;; none ;; Scope technique outside the oracle (EXC-013).
C x.log-correlation EX RUN-013 DEFAULT ;; Prefer platform/runtime trace identifiers for correlation; add an explicit correlation id only when an integration/operational requirement needs it; propagate tracing context across outbound calls with the chosen infrastructure. ;; = ;; none ;; Correlation implementation is technique outside the oracle (EXC-013).
C sec003.validate-correlation-id OL SEC-003 MUST ;; Validate or normalize a correlation identifier accepted from an external client before propagating it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run014.specific-properties OL RUN-014,SEC-010 MUST ;; Watch for authorization headers and full request/response bodies; log specific needed properties instead of whole objects; avoid dumping full objects without review. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run008.loggermessage-measured OL RUN-008 DEFAULT ;; Normal structured ILogger logging suffices; source-generated LoggerMessage only for measured high-volume hot paths, not everywhere. ;; = ;; Measured hot path. ;;
C dep010.no-provider-apis-in-app OL DEP-010,DEP-021 AVOID ;; Avoid provider-specific logging APIs throughout Application code (application code depends on ILogger<T>). ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.log-no-audit-db EX - AVOID ;; Avoid using logs as an audit database unless a dedicated audit design has been adopted. ;; = ;; Adopted audit design. ;; Anti-pattern not in the oracle.

C x.serilog-bootstrap EX DEP-021 DEFAULT ;; Use two-stage (bootstrap logger) Serilog initialization when startup logging matters; simpler apps may use host-managed setup. ;; = ;; Simpler applications without startup-logging needs. ;; Bootstrap technique not in the oracle.
C dep021.config-levels-sinks OL DEP-021 DEFAULT ;; Keep log levels, sinks and overrides in configuration so they change per environment without redeployment. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep021.serilog-apis-at-boundary OL DEP-021,DEP-010 MUST ;; Keep direct Serilog APIs (Log.Logger, LogContext) at composition or provider-specific boundaries. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run014.limit-destructuring OL RUN-014 MUST ;; Limit destructuring of large object graphs in logs. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.serilog-flush EX - DEFAULT ;; When using Serilog's static/bootstrap Log.Logger flush it on shutdown; for purely host-managed logging follow the provider lifetime instead of static lifecycle code. ;; = ;; none ;; Serilog lifecycle technique not in the oracle.
C x.serilog-elastic-sink EX DEP-004 DEFAULT ;; Use the official Elastic.Serilog.Sinks package instead of the deprecated Serilog.Sinks.Elasticsearch when writing to Elasticsearch. ;; = ;; Only when Elasticsearch is used. ;; Package-specific replacement guidance not in the oracle.
